# Sample exports

Invented data in the column layouts each app uses, for the importer tests. The Proton Pass
and LastPass layouts follow those apps' current CSV exports; Apple's and Google's follow
their documented import/export columns; 1Password's (1Password 8) and Dashlane's are read by
the generic reader, by column name. Replace a file here with a scrubbed real export (a
throwaway account) whenever an app changes its layout.
